{{Quote|Not for the faint of heart! This zesty slider features a patty topped with mouthwatering Zeltron pop-peppers, pink lettuce, magenta onions and spicy "pleasure planet" sauce. |Dex's Diner menu, on the Zeltros slider|<ref name="Dining at Dex's" />}}
A '''Zeltron pop-pepper''' was a type of [[Pepper/Legends|pepper]]<ref name="Dining at Dex's" /> that shared its name with the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Zeltros/Legends|Zeltros]] and the [[Zeltron/Legends|Zeltron]], the worlds [[Homeworld/Legends|native]] [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Species/Legends|species]].<ref name="Guide to Alien Species">''[[The Essential Guide to Alien Species (real-world book)|''The Essential Guide to Alien Species'']]''</ref> Zeltron pop-pepper were used to make the [[Zeltros slider]]s that were sold at [[Dex's Diner/Legends|Dex's Diner]]<ref name="Dining at Dex's" /> on [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]]<ref name="Guide to Alien Species" /> planet [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. The diner's menu described the peppers as mouthwatering.<ref name="Dining at Dex's" />

==Behind the scenes==
Zeltron pop-peppers were mentioned in "[[Dining at Dex's]]," an article written by [[Gregory Walker]] as an [[in-universe]] menu for Dex's Diner that was published on the [[Hyperspace: The Official Star Wars Fan Club|Hyperspace]] section of [[StarWars.com]] on [[December 3]], [[2009]].<ref name="Dining at Dex's" />
